dict.string: SyncHz needs access to Apple Music to read the current track and control playback.
SyncHz needs access to Apple Music playback information.
SyncHz needs audio input access to receive Apple Music's sound for the headphone EQ. It never records your microphone.
SyncHz taps Apple Music's audio to apply your headphone EQ before it reaches your output device.
SyncHz needs access to your media library to read now playing metadata.
